test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Choose the word from the given options which fits in the blank labelled 4 and gives correct meaning
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes** the bird initially being frozen and then feeling warm and happy due to being covered in cow dung.**
 
• The word** "thawing"** means to become **warm enough to change from frozen to a liquid state, which fits the context of the bird warming up.**
 
• The other options –** "chilling," "drawing," and "killing" – do not fit the context o**f the bird becoming warm and happy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *The dung was actually **thawing**__ her out!*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Chilling**" means causing coldness, which is opposite of "thawing."
 
• "**Drawing**" refers to pulling or attracting something, which does not fit this context.
 
• "**Killing**" means causing death, which is not relevant to the context of the bird becoming warm.
